text: BingX is a crypto exchange and Web3 company founded in 2018, serving more than 40 million users; Ferrari announced that it will become a Team Partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP with the agreement taking effect on 1 January 2026.
short: BingX is a crypto exchange and Web3 company founded in 2018.

source.name: Ferrari – BingX Team Partner page
source.quote: BingX is a leading crypto exchange and Web3 company, empowering over 40 million users worldwide to go further. Founded in 2018

additionalSources.name: Ferrari – Ferrari signs a multi-year partnership agreement with BingX
additionalSources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement – signed today and taking effect on January 1, 2026 – BingX will become a Team Partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP.
